description.narrative: Government and partners at national and sub-national level capacities are strengthened to design innovative climate-resilient Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH), and ensure optimum investments to provide quality, inclusive and safely managed Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) services at targeted poor Communities, schools, and health centers in rural deprived areas. This work breakdown structure activity contributed to sublevel results - Climate change, disaster risks and envionmental degradation,Safely managed drinking water, sanitation and hygiene

title.narrative: UNICEF supported the strengthening of national systems, advancing climate-resilient WASH services, and supporting effective emergency response. Through government-led coordination, enhanced climate financing capacity, and the development of strategic tools such as WASH accounts and budget briefs, UNICEF reinforced evidence-based planning and resource allocation. Improved integration with the education, health, and nutrition sectors further enhanced cross-sector outcomes.
